title: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter
responsibility: Preserve submitted task source as Git objects without moving source HEAD or changing user indexes.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: A checkout whose common Git directory identifies the task repository.

inputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint.input
inputs.description: Task checkout, expected source commit and exact paths to capture in a private index.

outputs.name: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint
outputs.description: A child commit containing the selected worktree paths, or the source commit when no paths were selected. The case compares committed contents and parent instead of the changing commit ID.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The checkout is from another repository, HEAD differs from source, or a Git operation fails.

test.title: submission checkpoint preserves source HEAD and both staged and unstaged work
